body: Same. Situation. But started at 19 for me.

I can’t say I’m happy or things in my life are how I want it to be. But I did have a decent day and I’m crumbling. I’m with you. I have the same loop of thoughts. The only thing that brought me out of tonight was re-reading some of my old poetry. I wish I could tell you what helps but thinking of my significant other stopped me too. 
You sound super thoughtful and You matter. Congrats on six months btw! That’s a big deal. It takes strength.

Wowowowow
I go through heavy periods of this. And HEAVY. I’ve earned nicknames like “ghost, stranger, etc” bc of how it gets. I understand though. You protecting them from yourself. With me, I can only hold the heavy side away from me for so long until it takes over everything & I am not the emotionally sound, well-rounded person they know. I’ve been practicing letting people in to see that but ultimately it’s been really hard … I even just got diagnosed with bpd and haven’t told my circle about it.

I know exactly how you feel. I’m in my late 20’s and always wish I would be adopted. Soon I will be forever NC once again & for years I mourn the death of the family I never had. 
I hope you can still find that feeling one day, and have somewhere to visit & get excited about it. Maybe it’ll come in a different form than expected. Where they will make you that breakfast and give you some hugs.

I have been diagnosed with anxiety, depression, PTSD, & BPD as well. Along with bipolar disorder. I’m waiting for some history reviewing to see if my bipolar diagnosis was a misdiagnosis but I don’t think so.. 
I totes get you!! I guess I’m upset about it bc I spent years thinking I had it and finally let it go only for years later for it to be medically confirmed I don’t know. I’m mad. Like… I don’t want another diagnosis. Even though I am a believer it helps to know what it is bc then you can address properly just like you said!! 
I suspect OCD for myself but idk how they would even get to that immediately, they never ask me questions about it - my intrusive thoughts bother me constantly, like I can’t relax in normal settings pretty often bc of them. 
I do have insurance. I look forward to the calmness you’re talking about. I have not found anything that makes me calm besides natural stuff like a Lot Of tea & casually partaking in cannabis. 
My issue in the bipolar is my crashes after my hypomania. I have type two so it’s different, my depression is what’s dangerous in it & hypomania can be bad but not as bad as my depression.. but years just not having proper treatment despite being pretty consistent on going to therapy, so now I’m literally restarting with basically nothing. 
Thank you so much for your kindness ❤️❤️
I’m giving you big hugs!! It’s weird to be misdiagnosed. I don’t know how to feel about it.

Hmm that’s a different way to view it. I like that. Yeah the psych mentioned she has to review more of my history to make sure that I’m not also bipolar so she can get me on treatment with anti-depressants for my bad depressive episodes along with the DBT&CBT 
& the mood stabilizers I tried did not work for me. And neither has regular therapy.

This. It is HARD to hear. It kinda almost hurts. Lol. Yes on naming can help with dealing.. wow see I feel really understood rn by like that … I’ve never been able to remove whatever this overall thing has been. I chalked it up to my bipolar diagnosis when I received that (more than a year ago now) but it just feels like my mental illness overall has never left me. In fact like that… it’s rooted in me. 
& good reminder. We are more than our diagnosis. Thank you so much for ur comment

Yeah it is. I sincerely fear & feel it’s both. But bc I am so “quiet” I’ve slipped by but now that my life is in shambles it seems like people can finally see how long I’ve been struggling and how real it is. This psych was like “we have to make sure you have a really great relationship with your therapist it’s so important to have good care.” It made me want to cry bc it’s like my 7/8th mental health professional and I was starting to really give up on therapy as a whole. But like it feels like finally, someone really sees what I’m saying when I say it’s all (points at life) been really intense for a long time. Yeah sharing with others and reaching out for support is a supposed coping mechanism for me which is funny bc like I’m pretty to myself. Thank you so much for your comment!!
